synchronous.title: Process Followed as Designed
synchronous.description: These are actions that matched the process exactly as intended. They show proper alignment with the defined workflow.

model.title: Expected Step Missing
model.description: These are activities the process model required but were not carried out. They highlight gaps where the workflow was incomplete.

log.title: Unexpected Step Occurred
log.description: These are actions recorded in execution that the process model did not anticipate. They reveal deviations or extra behavior outside the expected flow.

activities.title: Unexpected Activities
activities.description: These are activities that were executed but are not part of the original process model. They represent deviations where additional steps were performed outside the defined workflow.

flow.title: Unexpected Flow
flow.description: These are connections between activities that deviate from the expected process flow. They show paths taken that differ from the standard routing defined in the process model.

endEvent.title: Unexpected End Event
endEvent.description: These are end events that deviate from the expected process flow. They show paths taken that differ from the standard routing defined in the process model.

lanes.title: Unexpected Lanes
lanes.description: These are lanes that contain activities which were done by roles not heavily present in the log.

unexpectedFrequency.title: Unexpected Activities
unexpectedFrequency.description: Activities that were executed but are not part of the original process model, as well as how many times they appear through the deviations.

unexpectedPerformance.title: Unexpected Activities
unexpectedPerformance.description: Activities that were executed but are not part of the original process model, as well as their average time.

unexpectedLanes.title: Unexpected Lanes
unexpectedLanes.description: These are lanes that contain activities deviating from the expected process flow, from which the roles associated with those activities are not heavily present in the log, indicating sections of the model where deviations occur.

modelMismatch.title: Model Mismatch
modelMismatch.description: There might be mismatches between activities incoming flows, frequency & outgoing flows due to hidden deviations. These mismatches can be seen when hovering the activity.
